name: Card
description: A title and any content in a Cloud box, with no border and rounded corners. It isn't a link. Its body is a slot for rich text, such as paragraphs, a list or a small table. It's the only card with a slot, and with an optional header above the body and footer below it.
sources: az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2365 (design-reviewed): 16px corners, 24px card padding, the 8px space below the title, the 16px space below the text, the Cloud fill and Tinta text
az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2273 (closes #2271): 18px body text; az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2286: its 28px line height
Arizona Bootstrap 5.2: the title's 30px line height (.h5)
Arizona Bootstrap 5.2: the header and footer padding, which follows the card padding

border.width.$description: Card border width: none, since the fill sets the card apart from the page. In a forced colors (high contrast) mode, which removes fills, draw a 1px border instead so the card keeps its edge.

body.description: The card's body, which is its slot: the title, then any rich text, such as paragraphs, a list or a small table, in the card's text type.

line-height.$description: Card title line height. The space below the title is measured from this line.

text.description: Each block of rich text in the slot, such as a paragraph or a list.

font.size.$description: Card text size: the same as body text.

line-height.$description: Card text line height: the same as body text.

header-footer.description: The optional header above the body and footer below it. Both have the same padding.

padding.y.$description: Space above and below the header's and footer's content: half the body's.
